rationale: C02 is a direct and material drafting source. The child consolidates and restates several of C02's operative Foreign Service fee rules, including the exclusive prescribed-fee rule, collection in United States coin or equivalent exchange value, and the exemption for services to American vessels and seamen with the same exception for undocumented vessels. The child also expressly revokes the July 22, 1953 order represented by C02. C19 is closely related as a later amendment to the same tariff and is likewise expressly revoked, but its sparse amendment language supplies much less of the child's text. C23 concerns a narrower consular fee delegation and revocation and does not provide comparable operative language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Officers of the Foreign Service of the United States shall charge and collect for official services performed abroad fees as prescribed in the following schedule
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All officers of the Foreign Service shall charge and collect for official services performed abroad such and only such fees as are prescribed by the President in the following Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees
shared_material.explanation: The child closely restates C02's core fee-charging rule while placing the tariff directly in the new order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: No fees other than those prescribed in the foregoing Tariff of Fees, or fees prescribed by or pursuant to an act of Congress, shall be charged or collected
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such and only such fees as are prescribed by the President in the following Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees, or as are prescribed by or pursuant to an act of Congress
shared_material.explanation: This is substantially identical exclusivity and statutory-exception language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All fees shall be collected in the coin of the United States or at its representative value in exchange.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All fees shall be collected in the coin of the United States or at its representative value in exchange.

shared_material.child_excerpt: no fees prescribed in the foregoing Tariff of Fees shall be charged or collected by consular officers for official services to American vessels and seamen. The term "American vessels" as used herein shall not include undocumented American vessels; and the fees prescribed in the said Tariff of Fees shall be charged and collected for official services performed for such undocumented vessels.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: No fees prescribed in the Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees shall be charged or collected for official services performed by officers of the Foreign Service for American vessels and seamen. The term "American vessels" as used herein shall not include American undocumented vessels; and fees prescribed in the said Tariff shall be charged and collected for official services performed for such vessels.
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward the same exemption, definition, exception, and operative sequence with only minor wording changes.
